entries.022429bc775c4ef7: This is a business of bicycle parking products under the company's own brand. For bicycle parking products such as bicycle racks, it handles everything from planning and development to design, manufacturing, sales and installation, maintenance, and operation of bicycle parking facilities. The Tokyo Sales Office in Taito-ku, Tokyo is the facility for this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥494 million.
entries.0b9f799cad6c8181: This is a business of made-to-order products received from automobile manufacturers. Mainly through sheet metal work, painting and resin molding, the company manufactures and sells exterior parts such as bumpers and spoilers, and a hand brake lever system. The Nishino Plant and Shimonara Plant in Kumagaya City, Saitama Prefecture are the production facilities for this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,619 million.
